reports.title: National Vision Holdings, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is updating its fiscal 2026 outlook for the 52 weeks ending January 2, 2027, as set forth below.

Prior Fiscal 2026 Outlook(As of August 12, 2026) | Updated Fiscal 2026 Outlook(As of November 12, 2026)
New Stores(1) | 30-35 | ~30
Adjusted Comparable Store Sales Growth(2) | 3.0% - 5.0% | 2.0% - 3.0%
Net Revenue | $2.037 billion - $2.076 billion | $2.019 billion - $2.038 billion
Adjusted Operating Income(2) | $119 million - $139 million | $119 million - $131 million
Adjusted Diluted EPS(2)(3) | $0.94 - $1.09 | $0.95 - $1.03
Depreciation and Amortization(4) | $92 million - $93 million | $92 million - $93 million
Interest(5) | $11 million - $13 million | $11 million - $13 million
Tax Rate(6) | ~30% | ~30%
Capital Expenditures | $72 million - $76 million | $72 million - $74 million
1 Assumes primarily America's Best new stores, does not include 20 Military store additions in April 2026.
2 Refer to “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below for more information.
4 Includes amortization of acquisition intangibles of approximately $0.7 million, which is excluded in the definition of Adjusted Operating Income.
5 Before the impact of gains or losses on change in fair value of derivatives and charges related to debt discounts and deferred financing costs.
6 Excluding the impact of vesting of restricted stock units and stock option exercises.
